workflow.name: Bug Bounty End-to-End Evidence Pipeline — Balanced v2.4
workflow.description: Scope-aware architecture and attack-surface mapping, per-flow fresh-context hypothesis fan-out, root-cause deduplication, adversarial verification, deterministic PoC, program gating, relative ranking, and final reporting. Import-valid v2.4: globally unique stage output keys, one consume-all dedup boundary, immutable program extras after dedup, deterministic mapping, non-lossy pre-verification consolidation, and explicit Web3 fork inputs. Balanced v2.4 restores one pre-verification coverage and root-cause consolidation barrier: every hypothesis branch completes before expensive verification, canonical candidates then fan out independently to final emission, and OpenKritt post-processing performs final finding deduplication and ranking.

steps.name: Freeze program scope contract
Map production architecture and trust boundaries
steps.content:
Using the frozen scope contract, map the production architecture of {{repo_full}} at {{commit_sha}}. Scope assets={{scope_in_scope_assets}}; deployment facts={{scope_deployment_facts}}; gaps={{scope_scope_gaps}}. Identify services/components, executable construction and registration paths, trust boundaries, roles, privileged actors, data stores, external integrations, and critical state related to in-scope assets. Cite ordered path:line:symbol evidence for production wiring. Exclude tests, examples, dead code, and out-of-scope components. Return exactly one architecture record. Do not hunt vulnerabilities.

Use deterministic enumeration before reasoning: ripgrep plus language-aware AST/compiler tooling when available. Perform {{extra.repeat_runs}} independent enumeration passes when supplied (default: 2), compare their coverage, and record any coverage gap.

steps.name: Map evidenced attack surface
steps.content:
Map every distinct externally reachable production entrypoint in the in-scope architecture. Include HTTP/GraphQL/gRPC/RPC/WebSocket/webhook, protocol/message/queue consumers, parsers, public contract functions, and exposed CLI/package boundaries where an untrusted actor controls input. For each entrypoint prove registration and production reachability; identify the least-privileged actor, controlled fields, state or privilege effect, and only the accepted impacts plausibly connected to that effect. Mark reachability proven/conditional/unproven and separate evidence from gaps. Do not emit unproven items unless the gap is itself needed to evaluate a concrete registered path. Do not report vulnerabilities.

Use deterministic enumeration before reasoning: ripgrep plus language-aware AST/compiler tooling when available. Perform {{extra.repeat_runs}} independent enumeration passes when supplied (default: 2), compare their coverage, and record any coverage gap.

steps.name: Trace one production flow per result
steps.content: Trace materially distinct production flows from {{surface_entrypoint_label}} at {{surface_entrypoint_file_path}}:{{surface_entrypoint_line}}. Actor={{surface_least_privileged_actor}}; controlled={{surface_attacker_controlled_inputs}}; reachability={{surface_reachability_status}}; evidence={{surface_reachability_evidence}}. Map Attacker Input -> Parsing/Normalization -> Validation -> Authorization -> Business Logic -> State Transition/External Call -> Terminal Effect. Include async continuations, transaction boundaries, retries, callbacks, and partial failures. Separate flows when guards, state transitions, privileged effects, or sinks differ. Return one record per flow with ordered path:line:symbol evidence. Do not report vulnerabilities.

steps.name: Hypothesis fan-out A: boundary and invariant attacks
steps.content: Fresh-context task for exactly one flow. Generate one record per concrete Entry Point x Vulnerability Class hypothesis for {{flow_flow_summary}} with trace={{flow_flow_trace}}, actor={{surface_least_privileged_actor}}, input={{flow_input_at_sink}}, terminal={{flow_terminal_action}}, and allowed-impact candidates={{flow_candidate_allowed_impacts}}. Focus only on code-relevant authorization, tenant/ownership, state-machine, replay/race, partial rollback, external-call, parser/trust-boundary, injection, disclosure, and resource-asymmetry failures. Tie each hypothesis to a suspected root cause and exact verification locations. Name the strongest guard likely to kill it. Return no generic checklist or unsupported impact.

steps.name: Hypothesis fan-out B: attacker sequence and variant analysis
steps.content: Independently analyze exactly one flow with fresh context: {{flow_flow_summary}}; trace={{flow_flow_trace}}; actor={{surface_least_privileged_actor}}; controlled input={{flow_input_at_sink}}; terminal={{flow_terminal_action}}; partial failure={{flow_partial_failure_behavior}}; allowed impacts={{flow_candidate_allowed_impacts}}. Start from realistic attacker sequences: alternate entrypoint, ordering, replay, duplicate submission, boundary value, canonicalization mismatch, callback, concurrency, stale state, and multi-component composition. Emit only hypotheses with a precise broken invariant, concrete root cause location, prerequisites, guards to inspect, falsification target, and an accepted-impact candidate. Do not see or rely on the other hypothesis run.

steps.name: Deduplicate and prioritize root causes
steps.content:
Review all hypotheses from the preceding depth: {{multi_output_depth_4}}. Cluster records that share the faulty operation or missing guard, attacker primitive, broken invariant, and terminal effect. A changed endpoint, payload, victim, CWE label, or symptom is the same bug when the fix is the same. Emit one canonical record per root bug with a stable fingerprint derived from commit, path, symbol, invariant, and primitive. Preserve conflicting evidence and gaps. Prioritize for verification by attacker control, reachability, concrete accepted impact, and falsifiability. Discard generic hardening and unsupported effects.

Coverage rule: consolidate only after every hypothesis branch has completed. Emit every distinct code-grounded root cause that still warrants hostile verification. Triage priority is advisory metadata only; never discard a candidate solely because it is not labeled high priority.

steps.name: Independently verify and reproduce candidate
Apply program gate and emit progressive finding

steps.name: Panic hypotheses: explicit and helper panics
steps.content: Fresh-context analysis of {{surface_method_name}} at {{surface_file_path}}:{{surface_line}}. Trace only callees reachable during this ABCI phase. Emit one hypothesis per attacker-triggerable direct panic, Must/require/assert helper, codec/store panic, reflection panic, or dependency panic candidate. For each, prove a candidate actor/input/state source, suspected panic site, consensus propagation mechanism, guard candidates, exact verification locations, accepted-impact candidate, and strongest falsification target. No finding yet.

steps.name: Panic hypotheses: arithmetic and numeric state
steps.content: Fresh-context analysis of {{surface_method_name}} at {{surface_file_path}}:{{surface_line}}. Enumerate reachable divisors, modulo operands, big-int/decimal helpers, conversions, total power/supply/rate denominators, and nil numeric values. Emit only code-grounded hypotheses where an untrusted transaction/proposer/validator/IBC/oracle/governance-reachable state can create the invalid value at the panic site. Include exact arithmetic and falsification guard. No finding yet.

steps.name: Panic hypotheses: nil, bounds, types, decoders
steps.content: Fresh-context analysis of {{surface_method_name}} at {{surface_file_path}}:{{surface_line}}. Inspect reachable dereferences, lookup results, ignored errors, typed-nil interfaces, collection indexes/slices, type assertions, reflection, protobuf/custom decoders, and empty-after-filter cases. Emit one record per precise actor-controlled panic hypothesis with source-to-site trace, state prerequisite, consensus propagation theory, candidate guards, and falsification target. No finding yet.

steps.name: Consensus hypotheses: determinism and resource asymmetry
steps.content: Fresh-context analysis of {{surface_method_name}} at {{surface_file_path}}:{{surface_line}}. Hunt deterministic consensus failures beyond language panics: non-deterministic iteration/time/randomness/external reads, inconsistent validation between CheckTx/DeliverTx/ProcessProposal, proposer/validator disagreement, gas-meter bypass, and bounded attacker-controlled CPU/memory/state amplification capable of stopping block progress under program rules. Emit only hypotheses tied to exact code and a non-volume-dependent trigger. No finding yet.

steps.content:
Review {{multi_output_depth_2}}. Merge hypotheses sharing the same panic/divergence operation, attacker primitive, required state, consensus effect, and fix. Emit canonical records with stable fingerprints. Preserve distinct trigger paths and conflicting evidence. Discard local-node-only crashes without accepted impact, configuration-only failures, unreachable code, generic hardening, and volume-only DDoS.

Coverage rule: consolidate only after every hypothesis branch has completed. Emit every distinct code-grounded root cause that still warrants hostile verification. Triage priority is advisory metadata only; never discard a candidate solely because it is not labeled high priority.

workflow.name: DeFi Permissionless Economic Exploit Pipeline — Balanced v2.4
workflow.description: General DeFi value-flow pipeline with evidence-based custody/provenance, invariant-specific fan-out, mandatory refutation, fork PoC, program impact mapping, and relative ranking. steps.name: Freeze DeFi program and deployment scope
Map permissionless value and accounting operations
steps.content:
Map every production-reachable in-scope external/public operation an unprivileged EOA or attacker contract can invoke that moves value or changes accounting. For each, prove deployed address/chain reachability if supplied; trace custody at rest versus atomic pass-through; exact source of every balance/surplus; other users' funds or approvals; internal totals; share/token/reserve/oracle math; rounding direction; callbacks; and state-update order. Name protected conservation/pricing/ownership invariants and candidate accepted impacts. Exclude privileged-only, view-only, unproven deployments, and out-of-scope dependencies. No hypotheses.

Use deterministic enumeration before reasoning: ripgrep plus language-aware AST/compiler tooling when available. Perform {{extra.repeat_runs}} independent enumeration passes when supplied (default: 2), compare their coverage, and record any coverage gap.

Web3 architecture expansion: identify whether the operation is reached through a transparent proxy, UUPS proxy, beacon, diamond/facet, minimal clone, metamorphic deployment, delegatecall-based module, or direct implementation. Trace proxy -> implementation/facet resolution, initializer state, upgrade authorization, storage slots/layout across relevant versions, selector routing, and every attacker-influenceable delegatecall target. Check deployed bytecode/configuration evidence rather than assuming source deployment.

For each operation, include its local cross-contract neighborhood: direct callers and callees, callbacks/hooks, shared storage/accounting dependencies, tokens/oracles/bridges it trusts, and related public operations that can prepare or consume its state. Follow at least two contract hops where source and deployment evidence permit. Populate the proxy/storage and cross-contract output fields even when the conclusion is "direct deployment / no relevant edge", with evidence.

steps.name: Economic hypotheses A: conservation and accounting
steps.content: Fresh-context analysis of operation {{surface_operation_label}} at {{surface_file_path}}:{{surface_line}}. Generate one hypothesis per precise permissionless conservation/accounting break: share inflation, mint/redeem mismatch, rounding drift that accumulates, fee/reward/index double counting, stale totals, donation/sync discrepancy, epoch/checkpoint/replay, or over-withdraw. Each must name fund source, real victim, exact arithmetic/direction, sequence, prerequisites, profit mechanism, candidate guards, accepted impact, and strongest falsification target. Reject any hypothesis that assumes unexplained funds/surplus or a malicious out-of-scope dependency.

Discard unexplained surplus, self-only loss, pure market risk, privileged paths, and unsupported deployment assumptions.
